author: KEXP
description: On their latest release 'Is It Now?,' LA-based trio Automatic sound the alarm with infectious synth punk arrangements. Our latest in-studio session invites the group in to share a performance of "Black Box" and more with host DJ Evie Stokes.
title: Automatic performs "Black Box" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP

Izzy Glaudini - Lead Vocals, Synth
